# Reviewed upstream files remain byte-identical. Hash every vendored input so a
# local/generated config cannot silently replace the pinned portable codec.
file(READ "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/SHA256SUMS.json" manifest)
string(JSON count LENGTH "${manifest}")
math(EXPR last "${count}-1")
foreach(n RANGE 0 ${last})
    string(JSON path MEMBER "${manifest}" ${n})
    string(JSON expected GET "${manifest}" "${path}")
    file(SHA256 "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/upstream/${path}" actual)
    if(NOT actual STREQUAL expected)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Pinned Opus digest mismatch: ${path}")
    endif()
endforeach()
enable_language(C)
function(player2_add_opus)
    # Scope upstream's build/install knobs; never disable PLAYER2's own CTest.
    set(BUILD_TESTING OFF)
    set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF)
    set(OPUS_BUILD_TESTING OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(OPUS_BUILD_PROGRAMS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(OPUS_BUILD_SHARED_LIBRARY OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(OPUS_INSTALL_PKG_CONFIG_MODULE OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(OPUS_INSTALL_CMAKE_CONFIG_MODULE OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(OPUS_DISABLE_INTRINSICS ON CACHE BOOL "Portable initial format admission" FORCE)
    set(OPUS_FIXED_POINT OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(OPUS_FLOAT_APPROX OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(OPUS_FAST_MATH OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(OPUS_DEEP_PLC OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(OPUS_DRED OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(OPUS_OSCE OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(OPUS_HARDENING ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    add_subdirectory(upstream)
endfunction()
player2_add_opus()
set_target_properties(opus PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
target_include_directories(opus SYSTEM INTERFACE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/upstream/include")
